They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became fascinated by mortal settlements.
They loved the nicely paved ground in the city.
They admired the intricate bridges over the streets.
Above all, they loved houses.
Stone walls formed shelters from the weather.
Those walls also connected the earth to family stories.
Pebble Spring decided to learn housebuilding.
A self-made staff offered a touch of arcane magic.
The first lesson was measuring a doorway.
The second lesson was raising a sturdy beam.
The third lesson was laying a level floor.
The fourth lesson was cutting clean stone.
The fifth lesson was sealing a leaky roof.
The sixth lesson was building a friendly hearth.
The seventh lesson was placing a bright window.
The eighth lesson was joining wood without cracks.
The ninth lesson was making a door swing smoothly.
The tenth lesson was shaping a small chimney.
The eleventh lesson was adding a cozy nook.
The twelfth lesson was polishing a stone threshold.
The thirteenth lesson was learning when to stop.
The fourteenth lesson was sharing the work with friends.
The fifteenth lesson was seeing the house come alive.
Pebble Spring finally understood that the houses he admired were not only strong walls and roofs, but also living stories told by every family, and those stories made the whole structure seem very quietly spotty today.
